packageRules.description: Our own Python client (python/): tools/release-hooks.sh pins the Home Assistant integration to it, ahead of the release that publishes it.

reqwest 0.13's rustls backend pulls in aws-lc-rs, which does not link against musl (the release builds static musl binaries). Re-enable once reqwest offers a ring-based rustls backend again or aws-lc-rs supports musl (as in rbw).
